key_icons: Round-ended silver keys with a grey outline, in three columns, the middle column set lower, each digit with its small letters to its right. The 1 key also shows a small envelope and voicemail icon (two small rings joined along their bottoms); the * key also shows a/A; the # key also shows a space symbol and a small silent (crossed note) symbol.
